title: Elsa was all the rage last night!
text: Elsa was all the rage last night!. What a great idea! I have a granddaughter (6 years old) who is a big Frozen fan. I put this on last evening, knowing my son and his wife and child were coming over for dinner. You should have seen the look on the little ones face when she saw me wearing this in the kitchen! I was the biggest hit of the evening, I know she would love this apron as well, but it is made for an adult. I am looking to try to get one for he in a children's size so she can be a character with me next time we bake cookies together. I think this is a cool little apron if you are a mom or grandmom hosting a kid's party in your home or even just some one on one baking party in your home. Colorful, fits well, an is a really cool way to entertain the kids!

product_metadata.title: ICUP Disney's Frozen Elsa Be The Character Apron
description: Now you can be the Snow Queen of Arendelle when you wear this Disney Frozen Elsa Be the Character Apron! It features adjustable ties so one size fits most adults. Cryokinetic superpowers not included. Made in the USA.Machine wash cold; do not bleach; tumble dry low; do not iron over decoration.
